items.label: Independence
items.value: Our grabber reacher tool excels in everyday tasks, boasting a remarkable 2-pound horizontal and 5-pound vertical load capacity. With its durable materials, it ensures long-term usability, assisting users with limited mobility, post-surgery recovery, and outdoor cleaning in safely reaching and pickup items.

items.label: Easy Control
items.value: Unlike other grabbers, the 32" reacher grabber pickup tool ensures the item's center of gravity stays closer to you during grabbing. Experience superior performance with its sturdy internal connecting wire and a sensitive trigger that reduces pressure on your hands and wrists, providing effortless control and operation.

items.label: Enhanced Jaw
items.value: Equipped with a 3.5" opening silicone jaw, the trash picker upper grabber ensures a non-slip grip when handling objects with smooth surfaces. Moreover, our grabbers claw is engineered to have a stronger grip, allowing it to securely hold small and thin objects such as pills, coins, and paper.

items.label: 360° Head & Magnet
items.value: Our grabber tool is designed with an innovative 360° rotating head and a magnet. The rotating head eliminates the need to twist your arm or wrist, allowing for effortless reach in any direction. Additionally, the magnets make it a breeze to pick up small metallic items like nails, batteries, and coins.

items.label: Space Saving
items.value: With its folding feature, it can shrink down to a compact size of 17 inches. After folding, you can makes it a breeze to store in smaller spaces. This grabber reacher, available in bold orange and refreshing blue, make enabling safe retrieval of items placed high up and picking up dropped items without bending over.
